verdict.rationale: Mercury's security page and homepage say partner banks' sweep networks automatically spread deposits across up to 20 banks, giving up to $5M in FDIC insurance without opening multiple accounts. Mercury Vault shows how funds are protected, and Mercury reports that 97%+ of deposits are insured. Mercury notes that pass-through insurance requires certain conditions to be met. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the sweep behavior, and detail on which conditions pass-through coverage depends on.
